descriptions.w3d_d24k_expand_message_8026fc98: Selects the message at +132 or +136 of the object at +40 and, when enabled and non-empty, reads the indexed list entry and replaces every '@' placeholder through 0x802ef380, 0x8020c3a0 and 0x8020c510, then passes the expanded text to 0x802b1258. An index past the count returns.
